# Externals

This directory contains vendored external resources which are unsuited for vcpkg or upstream are no longer active

* js - ThreeJS and JPEGEncoder
* mikktspace - Blender Mikktspace - code relatively static and unchanging
* rpmalloc - mjansson/rpmalloc allocator, pinned to release 2.0.1 - link-time malloc/free/new/delete override, no vcpkg port exists upstream
* tut - TUT unit testing library - Upstream inactive
